text: "Peddler Ivo's sat in the square with an empty cart and a face like a wet Tuesday. Ambushed on the North Road, they say. Redmaw's crew."
"Old Sal, out on Fenwater? Pays coin for dead lights, I hear. Don't ask me how you kill a light. Don't ask her either, she'll tell you."
"Sister Aldith's been at her candles all week. Chapel bell across the fen rang itself, and the Light's folk don't care for bells with opinions."
"There's a howl out of the deep Darkwood some nights that ain't off any wolf Borin bought a pelt from. Bigger. Older. My dog won't sleep outside now."
"Flour's milled by noon, gossip's fresh all day. That's the miller's trade, friend - grain and news, and only one of them's ever stale."
